title: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing?
summary: Lenders don't want SpaceX shooting their collateral into orbit. What does that mean for space data centers writ large?
llm_summary: Space‑grade chips can now survive the harsh conditions of orbit, but getting the money to build and operate them is another story. Lenders are wary of financing projects like SpaceX’s orbital data centers because the collateral—hardware literally shot into space—can’t be reclaimed if the venture fails. This financing reluctance could slow the rollout of large‑scale space‑based data centers, even as the technology itself becomes viable.
